questions.prompt: The general defended himself bravely against the enemy.
questions.answer: Dux sē fortiter contrā hostēs dēfendit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers hid themselves in the dense forest.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs sē in silvā dēnsā cēlāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The wise man loves his own friends more than himself.
questions.answer: Vir sapiēns amīcōs suōs plūs quam sē amat.

questions.prompt: The queen adorned herself with gleaming jewels.
questions.answer: Rēgīna sē gemmīs fulgentibus ōrnāvit.

questions.prompt: He besought me to defend him against his own enemies.
questions.answer: Mē ōrāvit ut sē contrā inimīcōs suōs dēfenderem.

questions.prompt: They begged the king to spare them.
questions.answer: Rēgem ōrāvērunt ut sibi parceret.

questions.prompt: The mother persuaded her son to follow her.
questions.answer: Māter fīliō persuāsit ut sē sequerētur.

questions.prompt: The captives beseeched the general to lead them into the camp.
questions.answer: Captīvī ducem ōrāvērunt ut sē in castra dūceret.

questions.prompt: The farmer sold his own crops in the crowded forum.
questions.answer: Agricola frūgēs suās in forō celebrī vēndidit.

questions.prompt: The poet enjoys his own fame.
questions.answer: Poēta fāmā suā fruitur.

questions.prompt: The old man left all his wealth to his own children.
questions.answer: Senex omnēs dīvitiās suās līberīs suīs relīquit.

questions.prompt: Forgetful of himself, the hero hurled himself into the flames.
questions.answer: Suī oblītus, hērōs in flammās sē iēcit.

questions.prompt: The philosopher, mindful of himself, avoided every danger.
questions.answer: Philosophus, suī memor, omne perīculum vītāvit.

questions.prompt: No longer master of himself, the man trembled with fear.
questions.answer: Vir, suī iam nōn potēns, metū tremēbat.

questions.prompt: The messenger announced that he had seen the enemy.
questions.answer: Nūntius sē hostēs vīdisse nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: The maiden thought that she would carry off the prize.
questions.answer: Virgō sē praemium reportātūram esse putābat.

questions.prompt: The prisoner promised that he would reveal everything.
questions.answer: Captīvus sē omnia patefactūrum esse pollicitus est.

questions.prompt: The king boasted that his own forces were unconquered.
questions.answer: Rēx cōpiās suās invictās esse glōriābātur.

questions.prompt: Freeing himself from his chains, the young man fled by night.
questions.answer: Sē vinculīs solvēns, iuvenis nocte profūgit.

questions.prompt: The commander, trusting in his own valor, drew up the battle line.
questions.answer: Imperātor, virtūte suā cōnfīsus, aciem īnstrūxit.

questions.prompt: The woman, having embraced her own children, wept for joy.
questions.answer: Fēmina, nātōs suōs amplexa, gaudiō flēvit.

questions.prompt: He devoted himself to the republic so much that he neglected his own safety.
questions.answer: Ita sē reī pūblicae dēdidit ut salūtem suam neglegeret.
